from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792484937/attempts/902a26a1d741414098c8ca31bef93000/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
# Create a task transform that detects base-color framed tiles on left, matches each tile's hole mask to right-hand object masks,
# then recolors its holes with the matched object's color.
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # ARC panels occupy left half; right half contains separated colored masks.
    base = next((v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,)), None)
    # Choose dominant nonzero color as the frame color.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    frame = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    left_w = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r in range(h))), w // 2)
    # Parse colored shapes from right half using 4-neighbor components.
    seen=set(); shapes=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(left_w+1,w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                    if 0<=q[0]<h and left_w<q[1]<w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==color:
                        seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
            shapes.append((color, frozenset((y-min(a for a,b in cells),x-min(b for a,b in cells)) for y,x in cells)))
    # Tile boundaries are full frame-color rows.
    separators=[r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c]==frame for c in range(left_w))]
    out=[row[:left_w] for row in grid]
    starts=[]
    for r in range(h):
        if r==0 or r-1 in separators: starts.append(r)
    for i,start in enumerate(starts):
        end=next((s for s in separators if s>start),h)
        tile=[grid[y][:left_w] for y in range(start,end)]
        holes={(y-start,x) for y in range(start,end) for x in range(left_w) if grid[y][x]==0}
        if not holes: continue
        miny=min(y for y,x in holes); maxy=max(y for y,x in holes); minx=min(x for y,x in holes); maxx=max(x for y,x in holes)
        mask=frozenset((y-miny,x-minx) for y,x in holes)
        for color,shape in shapes:
            if shape==mask:
                for y,x in holes: out[y][x]=color
                break
    return out
'''
(base/'task-04216df0.py').write_text(code)
